changes.title: Softer tilt shift
items: A gentler tilt-shift: about half the blur at the top and bottom of the screen, and a wider sharp band, on the ground and in the treetops

changes.title: Legend boon direction
items: A legend's circle now tells you what its boon is (its name, what it does, and its sigil, as on the buff bar)
A dreaming legend's bubble points the way to the nearest area where the animal it dreams of lives: a pixel arrow on its edge and the direction and distance under the sigil, kept up as you move

changes.title: Shadow audit
items: Sleeping legends lie over their own shadows: the fox, elk and beaver were drawn metres to one side of where they lie
Sleeping animals sit exactly on the ground, and the witch stands on the ground itself when she lands on a slope
Party animals keep their party gear on when they fall asleep

changes.title: Pixel lines
items: Projectiles, sparks, the leash's beads and the attack rings are drawn in chunky art pixels now, with their glow still soft round them
The ley line is much easier to see: a bright pixel line with a soft glow, on every ground and from the treetops; its pulse and the boot ring are pixels too
The ley line shows along its whole length, from the treehouse to its tip, as bright all the way: through the trees, over the hills, and on into every stone
Invitations are pixel art now as they spin, orbit, fall and rest, their pixels lined up with everything else's

changes.title: No walking away
items: Charging and leaping creatures can no longer be escaped by just walking away: charges run on until they catch you and leaps land where you're going
A well-timed blink, sideways or straight through a charge, gets you clear, and the charger stands winded for a moment: the time to land your 💌s

changes.title: Legend layers
items: An angry legend now bombards your soundsystems when you're out of its reach, though it always goes for you first
Legend buffs from quests and relics can be made stronger, and happy legends can reach further (sliders on the decisions panel)
A trial switch on the decisions panel: a legend that turns angry stamps on its own area's soundsystem

changes.title: Floor sigil
items: The carving on each legend circle's floor is now the legend's own sigil, rune bands, medallions and all, half lost under the moss

changes.title: Creator sliders
items: The broom has a thickness slider beside its length, for every kind of broom (a skinny stick to a fat missile or a tub of a canoe), saved with her and drawn in flight and on the party witches

Every slider in the character creator now changes her for every option: the hat's lean works on every hat, the little hat's height, brim and band work, the traffic cone's base and stripes and the crown's and mushroom's glow follow the brim and band sliders; and sliders that can't apply are greyed out (no hat's height, a beanie's brim, a canoe's bend, a drone's bristles, no cloak's length)

changes.title: Bot game buffs
items: In the bot game the skilled witch now does a few legend quests, brings relics to the legends by the coming waves, and leads her young creatures to berries
